instruction: A cinematic still captured from a slightly low angle in a medium shot. On an outdoor wooden boardwalk with a metal railing, surrounded by lush green trees, four friends are interacting. On the left, the man in the orange t-shirt (R2) stands in profile facing right, clasping hands with the man in the grey t-shirt (R4) who stands on the right facing left. Between them, the woman in the beige hoodie (R1) stands facing right, while the woman in the grey hijab (R3) stands second from the right, smiling as she watches the hand clasp. Bright, warm sunlight filters through the canopy, creating a backlit effect with a warm color palette.
elements: R2 clasps hands with R4 rather than with R1 or R3
R4 is the hand-clasp partner of R2 rather than an onlooker
R3 watches the hand clasp instead of participating in it
R1 stands between the interacting pair without being part of the hand clasp
the interaction occurs on an outdoor wooden boardwalk with a metal railing
